about: #6177: owner-approved replacement summary lines (owner ruling 2026-11-22, final approval section 10) for published chapters whose served summary carried a factual error or restated a withheld comparison. Each is the first sentence(s) of the chapter's approved second-edition summary. Applied only behind www/src/lib/chapter_truth.js CHAPTER_TRUTH_LIVE, and only while the served summary still begins with `replaces` (once a second edition serves its own summary, the entry retires itself). Read by www/src/lib/chapter_truth.js and scripts/v4_build_rss.py.

week-05.replaces: He weighed 318.9 pounds on Day 10, down 8.4 from
week-05.text: He weighed 318.9 pounds on Day 10, 8.4 below the first weigh-in, and the platform's rate flag was lit.

week-08.replaces: After 23 consecutive training days, three rest days this week sent recovery to 98%
week-08.text: After 23 days in a row, three days without a weight session, a 12-mile walk, four mornings at 98 percent recovery and the scale under 310 for the first time.

week-09.replaces: The Monday afternoon walk covered 5.4 miles in just under two hours,
week-09.text: Four weight sessions, three walks, no day without one, and the heaviest bench press of the experiment. The scale reached 305.4.

week-12.replaces: Monday's weigh-in read 292.6 pounds. A 5.2-pound week tripped the platform's rate flag
week-12.text: Between the Monday weigh-ins of 2 and 9 November the scale fell 5.2 pounds and the platform's rate flag was lit.
